content_sections.heading: Wanaparthy District Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selections will be done based on marks obtained in qualifying examinations or written tests, along with age weightage and reservation rules. For AYUSH Doctor with PG Qualification, AYUSH Medical Officer, Pharmacists, Dieticians, Psychosocial Counselor and Yoga Professional: 90 marks will be allotted based on the marks obtained in the qualifying examination, and 10 marks for age weightage (0.5 mark for one completed year of age starting from 18 years, up to a maximum of 10 marks). For Multi-Purpose Worker (MPW): 90 marks will be allotted for a written test conducted by the concerned authorities, and 10 marks will be awarded for age weightage. Merit list will be prepared based on marks obtained and displayed on the official website. Selection lists will follow the rule of reservation and Presidential Order. Psychosocial Counselors will be empaneled and engaged on a call basis as and when required.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Wanaparthy District Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form and instructions from the official website of Wanaparthy District. Fill out the application form carefully with all required details. Attach self-attested copies of all necessary certificates and documents. Submit the filled-in application form in person or through Registered Post to the O/o. the District Collector & Magistrate, Wanaparthy District. Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 22-10-2026 by 05:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: SSC or equivalent examination certificate Intermediate or 10+2 examination certificate Qualifying Examination Pass Certificate Marks memos of all the years of the qualifying examination Registration certificates of Board of Indian Medicine (for AYUSH Medical Officer Post) Registration certificate of the Telangana Pharmacy Council (for Pharmacist post) Latest Caste Certificates issued by the Tahsildar / MRO concerned Study certificate from 4th Class to 10th class (or residency certificate for Private Study from the Tahsildar / MRO concerned) PH certificate in respect of candidates claiming reservation under PH Quota Relevant certificates for candidates claiming Ex-serviceman quota 1 Photograph duly pasted on the application form Acknowledgment card

content_sections.heading: Wanaparthy District Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received after the due date (22-10-2026) will be summarily rejected. The District Selection Committee is not responsible for postal delays. The recruitment is made on an outsourcing basis up to 31.03.2027 and thereafter services will continue as per need and satisfactory performance. Rules of Reservation in respect of Community, Disability, and Ex-service Men are strictly observed as per Telangana State and Subordinate Service Rules, 1996. Local reservation rules are applicable as per the Presidential Order.

faq.question: Q1. What is Wanaparthy District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Wanaparthy District Recruitment 2026 is an offline recruitment notification issued to engage 8 personnel on an outsourcing basis for various AYUSH Public Health Programmes up to 31 March 2027.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 8 vacancies are available across AYUSH Medical Officer, Pharmacist, Psychosocial Counselor, Yoga Professional, and Multi Purpose Worker (MPW) posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit applications?
faq.answer: The last date to submit filled-in application forms in person or through registered post is 22 October 2026 up to 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for an AYUSH Medical Officer?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in Ayurveda, Unani, Homoeopathy, or Naturopathy awarded by a recognized university after a regular course of study for not less than 4 ½ years duration with one year compulsory internship.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years as on 01/07/2026, with age relaxations applicable for SC, ST, BC, ex-servicemen, and disabled candidates.
